# MOJO4K.DE – Bester IPTV Anbieter Deutschland

## About
MOJO4K.DE is Germany's leading IPTV provider. We offer 50,000+ live channels in 4K Ultra HD for customers across Germany and German-speaking markets.

## Service
- 50,000+ live TV channels in HD and 4K Ultra HD
- Full German channel lineup: ARD, ZDF, RTL, Sat.1, ProSieben, Sky Sport (all packages), DAZN, Eurosport
- International channels: Turkish, Arabic, English, French, Spanish and more
- VOD library: thousands of movies and series on demand
- EPG: 14-day electronic program guide for all channels
- Anti-freeze technology: 99.9% uptime
- Compatible with: Amazon Fire TV Stick, Samsung Smart TV, LG Smart TV, Android Box, iPhone, iPad, Android, Windows PC, Mac, Apple TV, Chromecast
- IPTV players supported: TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, XCIPTV, Smart IPTV, SS IPTV, VLC, Kodi
- Connection protocol: Xtream Codes API and M3U playlist

## Pricing
Plans from €9/month. No contract. Monthly, 3-month, 6-month and 12-month plans available.
Up to 10 simultaneous connections available.
Free 24-hour trial: https://mojo4k.de/iptv-gratis-testen/
